mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_home_log ( HTTP_HOST, HTTP_CONNECTION, HTTP_USER_AGENT, HTTP_REFERER, HTTP_ACCEPT, HTTP_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE, REMOTE_ADDR, SCRIPT_FILENAME, REMOTE_PORT, GATEWAY_INTERFACE, SERVER_PROTOCOL, REQUEST_METHOD, QUERY_STRING, REQUEST_URI, SCRIPT_NAME, PHP_SELF, REGDATE, USERID, url, referer, ip, user_agent, language, uid, enr_dt ) VALUES ( #{HTTP_HOST}, #{HTTP_CONNECTION}, #{HTTP_USER_AGENT}, #{HTTP_REFERER}, #{HTTP_ACCEPT}, #{HTTP_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE}, #{REMOTE_ADDR}, #{SCRIPT_FILENAME}, #{REMOTE_PORT}, #{GATEWAY_INTERFACE}, #{SERVER_PROTOCOL}, #{REQUEST_METHOD}, #{QUERY_STRING}, #{REQUEST_URI}, #{SCRIPT_NAME}, #{PHP_SELF}, datetime('now', 'localtime'), #{USERID}, #{REQUEST_URI}, #{HTTP_REFERER}, #{REMOTE_ADDR}, #{HTTP_USER_AGENT}, #{HTTP_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE}, #{USERID}, datetime('now', 'localtime') )
mapper.sql:
WHERE 1=1
AND u_id LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'

mapper.select: SELECT ${pageNo} PAGENO, TOTAL, PAGES, STARTPAGE, CASE WHEN ENDPAGE > PAGES THEN PAGES ELSE ENDPAGE END ENDPAGE FROM ( SELECT TOTAL, CASE WHEN TOTAL = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((TOTAL + ROWCOUNT - 1) / ROWCOUNT) END PAGES, (((PAGE - 1) / STEP) * STEP + 1) STARTPAGE, (((PAGE - 1) / STEP + 1) * STEP) ENDPAGE FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) TOTAL, ${pageNo} PAGE, ${ViewRow} ROWCOUNT, ${ViewPage} STEP FROM t_user ) A2 ) A1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (u_id, u_name, u_passwd, u_mobile, u_email, u_status, u_dept, u_auth, u_site, u_cud) VALUES (#{uId}, #{uName}, #{uPasswd}, #{uMobile}, #{uEmail}, #{uStatus}, #{uDept}, #{uAuth}, #{uSite}, #{uCud})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET u_passwd = #{uPasswd}, u_status = #{uStatus}, u_err_cnt = 0, u_err_dt = NULL, u_status = #{uStatus}, u_name = #{uName}, u_mobile = #{uMobile}, u_email = #{uEmail}, u_dept = #{uDept}, u_auth = #{uAuth}, u_site = #{uSite}, u_cud = #{uCud} WHERE u_id = #{uId}
UPDATE t_user SET u_status = #{uStatus} WHERE u_id = #{uId}
